title: Candidate touchpoints — quick log & daily checklist
content:
Daily quick log — March 14–15
Inbox zero attempt before standup

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Confirm times with 3 candidates who asked to move window to late afternoon (PST). Double-check interviewers' cal availability before confirming.
- [ ] Send candidate prep packet + travel/parking notes for onsite on Friday (REQ-412). Attach updated interview rubric.
- [ ] Chase feedback from panel for Mangesh (SWE2) — interviews completed yesterday, need consolidated notes for hiring manager by EOD.
- [ ] Reschedule recruiter screens for timezone mismatches (one candidate accidentally booked EST slot) — offer 9:30am/1:30pm PST options.

Short touchpoint notes (quick actions)
- Priya K. (SWE2) — phone screen 11:00am PT. Remind interviewer to use phone bridge (internal # masked). Candidate asked about relocation stipend — flag to hiring manager.
- Omar H. (Data Eng) — accepted verbal invite for virtual loop; send calendar invite with Zoom + interview kit (include code sample link). Reminder: include sign-on prefix in invite title.
- Dana R. (PM) — still waiting on pre-interview exercise submission. If nothing by 5pm, send gentle nudge but don't push for exception.

Calendar housekeeping
- Block 12:30–1:30pm for debriefs and offer notes (no candidate calls).
- Create 30m buffer after each panel where possible (recommended for panel to finish and jot notes).
- Check #recruiting-schedules Slack for any last-minute interviewer swaps — respond within 10m.

ATS / paperwork
- Update ATS stage for candidates who completed on-site loop: move to "decision pending" and attach panel summary.
- Upload signed NDAs (from vendor) to candidate folder when received.
- Background check: submit forms for Laila S. once recruiter confirm email returned. Vendor turnaround ~48–72h.

Hiring manager & stakeholder follow-ups
- HM (SWE Manager, Nadia) — quick sync 3:15pm PT re: hiring rubric alignment for Senior SWE. Agenda: 3 must-haves, interview weighting, salary band confirmation.
- Ops partner (Marta) — ask about relocation policy for international hires; need official text for offer letter template.

Open questions / things to escalate
- Visa sponsorship? Flagged on two candidate profiles (REQ-410). Need legal/comp sign-off before next step.
- Salary band for Senior PM — hiring manager not replied. If no reply by noon, escalate to talent partner.

Notes to self (personal)
- Keep tone concise in candidate messages — copy of interview prep in first paragraph.
- Use subject prefix: [Redwood Recruiting] for all candidate mails today so replies are friendlier/clearer in shared inbox.
- Remember to add panel composition to calendar invites (role + initials).

Quick canned messages (templates to paste)
- Confirm time: "Thanks for your flexibility — confirming your interview on [DATE] at [TIME] PT. Please join via the Zoom link in the calendar invite; let me know if you need any adjustments."
- No-show follow-up: "We missed you at your interview. If you still want to proceed please respond with availability in the next 48 hours and we'll reschedule."

EOD checklist
- [ ] Update ATS statuses + attach notes
- [ ] Send any outstanding candidate prep or reschedule confirmations
- [ ] Move action items to tomorrow's list (flag high priority)

Random reminders
- Prep one-pager for Friday onsite: parking, campus check-in, lunch options, COVID policy — share with PM and Ops for a quick review.
- Add reminder to talk to payroll about sign-on bonus processing timeline (needed for offer step).

Quick log of outreach (timestamps)
- 08:14 — emailed Priya confirmation + prep packet
- 09:07 — Slacked Nadia to confirm salary band; no reply yet
- 10:32 — sent calendar invite to Omar (virtual loop)
- 11:50 — pinged panel for Mangesh feedback

End of notes — will update after 3:15pm sync and move unresolved items to tomorrow.
